collapses_to.tool: a single idempotency-keyed ingest that takes a change-control attestation for a window — the population, the separations that did not hold, and an owner with a validity period — and files the exceptions and the period record together, instead of one security-finding call per exception plus an evidence create the client has to thread

idempotency.verified_at: The "Idempotency/Upsert Behavior" section of https://api.noru.tech/llms.txt documents POST /v1/security-findings as an upsert on (source, externalId): an existing finding with the same pair is updated in place rather than duplicated. The createSecurityFinding tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp is the MCP surface over the same operation.

The createEvidence tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp documents creating text/note/link evidence with optional control mappings and documents no idempotency key. The "Idempotency/Upsert Behavior" section of https://api.noru.tech/llms.txt covers assets and security findings only.
idempotency.gap: No idempotency key is documented for evidence, so this piece embeds a marker built from the window and a digest of the rendered attestation in the evidence description, and probes getOrganizationEvidence before creating. A documented key would let the probe go away.

idempotency.verified_at: The linkEvidenceToControl tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp documents attaching an existing evidence record to a control. Nothing published says whether linking the same pair twice is a no-op, so this piece does not assume it is.
idempotency.gap: The evidence id is learned from the create in the same plan, so the call carries depends_on and the executing client substitutes it. A documented key on evidence would remove both this probe and the one above.

source.note: The organization's controls and their status. Ids come from Noru; this plugin ships none.

What the framework expects of a control, what is already linked, and the procedure an auditor follows. Which change-management separations this organization must hold to is Noru's answer, never this plugin's.
Every evidence record linked to a control with its status and expiry. A change-control record that expired is a window that is due again.
Findings already open for this source, so an exception that has since been remediated is closed by the same upsert that filed it rather than duplicated.

exit_codes.1: drift, validation failure, missing prerequisite input, or a stale plan
exit_codes.2: usage error, including a push without --confirm
